nuggets.text: Blue Devils coach Manny Diaz's father once served as mayor of Miami.
Blue Devils coach Manny Diaz started out as an ESPN production assistant; the last highlight reel he cut was the 1997 Masters.
The 1942 Rose Bowl was moved to Durham over wartime fears after Pearl Harbor; the Blue Devils lost 20-16 to Oregon State.
Blue Devils running back Nate Sheppard ran for a career-best 227 yards and two touchdowns in the 17-3 opener over Tulane.
Blue Devils RB Nate Sheppard had more first-half touches vs. Tulane than in Duke's first three games of last season combined.
The Blue Devils' opener against Tulane kicked off 90 minutes late because of severe weather.
The Blue Devils come to Champaign as the reigning ACC champions.
The Blue Devils won nine games in both 2024 and 2025, just the second time in program history they did it in back-to-back years.
The Blue Devils were once coached by Steve Spurrier, who won a share of the 1989 ACC title before leaving for Florida.
The Blue Devils held Tulane without a touchdown, the Green Wave's first such game since a 2019 loss at Auburn.
